basic_details.job_title: KEA Industrial Expansion Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 35 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Karnataka Examinations Authority, Bengaluru (KEA) has invited applications for 35 posts of Industrial Expansion Officer under Advt No. ಇಡಿ/ಕೆಇಎ/30/ನೇ.ವಿ/2026 (RPC). The online application is open from 18 November 2026 to 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only. Last date to pay the fee: 16 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 18 years; maximum 40 years for General Merit, 43 years for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B, 45 years for SC / ST / Category-1 (as on the last date fixed for submitting applications)

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor Degree in Engineering (B.E) or Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or Bachelor degree in Science or Commerce or Business Administration/Business Management from a University established by Law
qualification.details: Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Engineering (B.E) or Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech); or Bachelor degree in Science; or Bachelor degree in Commerce; or Bachelor degree in Business Administration/Business Management from an University established by Law Age limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 40 years for General Merit, 43 years for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B, 45 years for SC / ST / Category-1 (as on the last date fixed for submitting applications) Age relaxation: Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B Maximum 43 years, SC / ST / Category-1 Maximum 45 years, Karnataka State Government / local authority / corporation employees Years of service or 10 years, whichever is less, Ex-servicemen Period of service plus 3 years, Full-time NCC Cadet Instructors Years served as Cadet Instructor, Village Group Trainers (Rural Industrialisation Scheme) Years served as Village Group Trainer, Persons with disabilities 10 years, Census organisation of Government of India in Karnataka employees Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less, Widows 10 years, Freed bonded labourers 10 years | Other conditions: | Must be a citizen of India Kannada Language Test must be passed with at least 50 out of 150 marks unless exempted Must be mentally and physically fit Degree marks card / certificate must be held by the last date

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay scale Rs. 54175-99400 (vacancy table); NPS applies

exam_pattern.details: 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer 0.25 marks deducted for a question with no option shaded on the OMR sheet (5th option is for unattempted questions) Exam in online (CBT) or offline OMR mode

how_to_apply: Open the link given on the KEA website https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/.
Fill in the application online between 18.11.2026 and 15.12.2026.
Enter the correct RD number of each reservation certificate claimed.
Upload a recent photograph (JPEG, white background, 50KB to 200KB) and signature (JPEG, 50KB to 70KB).
Pay the fee online only by 16.12.2026.
Download a copy of the application and keep the fee challan until the recruitment ends.
important_instructions: Post-wise and category-wise vacancy details are published separately and are tentative No change or correction is allowed once the application is submitted Reservation not claimed in the application will not be considered later Exam centre cannot be changed for any reason Original ID card and admit card compulsory at the exam centre Mobile number and email given in the application are final

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Engineering (B.E) or Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech); or Bachelor degree in Science; or Bachelor degree in Commerce; or Bachelor degree in Business Administration/Business Management from an University established by Law Age limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 40 years for General Merit, 43 years for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B, 45 years for SC / ST / Category-1 (as on the last date fixed for submitting applications) Age relaxation: Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B Maximum 43 years, SC / ST / Category-1 Maximum 45 years, Karnataka State Government / local authority / corporation employees Years of service or 10 years, whichever is less, Ex-servicemen Period of service plus 3 years, Full-time NCC Cadet Instructors Years served as Cadet Instructor, Village Group Trainers (Rural Industrialisation Scheme) Years served as Village Group Trainer, Persons with disabilities 10 years, Census organisation of Government of India in Karnataka employees Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less, Widows 10 years, Freed bonded labourers 10 years Other conditions: Must be a citizen of India Kannada Language Test must be passed with at least 50 out of 150 marks unless exempted Must be mentally and physically fit Degree marks card / certificate must be held by the last date

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for KEA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates awaiting the result of the qualifying degree exam on the last date Persons permanently debarred by UPSC, any State PSC or KEA A man with more than one living wife, or a woman married to a man with another wife, without prior government permission Persons convicted of moral turpitude, or temporarily debarred, until the government reviews the case

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Probation of two years for candidates selected by direct recruitment Covered by the National Pension Scheme (NPS)

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online only. Last date to pay the fee: 16 December 2026.

rows.category: SC / ST / Category-1 / Ex-serviceman / Third gender

rows.event: Kannada Language Test (3.00 PM to 5.00 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will KEA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Competitive examination: Paper-1 (General Knowledge) and Paper-2 (Specific Paper), to be held in February 2027 Compulsory Kannada Language Test (qualifying, unless exempted) Verification of original documents Paper-1 General Knowledge: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours Paper-2 Specific Paper: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours; syllabus published separately Minimum 35% marks in the competitive exam is compulsory Kannada Language Test: 150 marks, minimum 50 to qualify; marks not counted for selection or seniority

content_sections.heading: KEA Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer 0.25 marks deducted for a question with no option shaded on the OMR sheet (5th option is for unattempted questions) Exam in online (CBT) or offline OMR mode

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Aadhaar card Marks cards of all subjects / semesters and convocation certificate / PDC of the qualifying degree SSLC or equivalent certificate / school transfer certificate / birth extract showing date of birth Caste and income certificates in prescribed formats with RD number (if claiming reservation) Rural, Kannada medium, ex-serviceman, third gender, sportsperson or disability certificates (if claiming) NOC from the appointing authority for in-service candidates, if selected

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KEA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Open the link given on the KEA website https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/. Fill in the application online between 18.11.2026 and 15.12.2026. Enter the correct RD number of each reservation certificate claimed. Upload a recent photograph (JPEG, white background, 50KB to 200KB) and signature (JPEG, 50KB to 70KB). Pay the fee online only by 16.12.2026. Download a copy of the application and keep the fee challan until the recruitment ends.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Post-wise and category-wise vacancy details are published separately and are tentative No change or correction is allowed once the application is submitted Reservation not claimed in the application will not be considered later Exam centre cannot be changed for any reason Original ID card and admit card compulsory at the exam centre Mobile number and email given in the application are final
